fullDescription: A deep navy and gold fintech SaaS marketing website: sticky blurred nav, split hero with a product dashboard mockup, trust logo band, six-card feature grid, big stats strip, security and compliance split, three-tier comparison pricing with a featured plan, CTA, and a six-column mega-footer.
prompt:
## Resumo
Build a faithful fintech SaaS marketing website (single long landing page) on a deep navy base with a refined gold accent: a sticky blurred nav, a split hero with a product dashboard mockup, a trust logo band, a six-card feature grid, a big four-stat strip, a security/compliance split with a 2x2 badge grid, a three-tier comparison pricing block with a featured 'Most popular' plan, a centered CTA, and a six-column mega-footer. The whole page reads as 'financial-grade trust': dark, precise, restrained gold, generous spacing, hairline rings.

## Estilo Visual
Palette (exact): page background navy-900 #0b1f3a; darker bands navy-950 #071630 (logo band, stats, pricing, footer); panels/cards navy-850 #0e2647; mock window header navy-800 #122d53; chart/secondary bars and idle elements navy-700 #1a3a66. Gold accent family: gold-400 #f7c75a, gold-500 #f0b429, gold-600 #d99a16. Buttons use a vertical gold gradient (from-gold-400 to-gold-500) with navy-950 #071630 label text; the brand logo tile is a from-gold-400 to-gold-600 diagonal gradient. Gradient headline words use a 180deg #f7c75a -> #f0b429 -> #d99a16 clip-text. Big stat numbers reuse that gold clip-text gradient. Text colors: headings white #ffffff, body slate-300/slate-200 (Tailwind), muted slate-400, disabled/struck rows slate-500. Borders are near-invisible: border-white/[0.06] to border-white/15, plus inset 1px hairline rings rgba(255,255,255,0.06) ('ring-hairline'). Accent borders/rings on cards use gold-500 at 20-40% alpha. Effects: faint radial-dot grain (radial-gradient rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px / 4px tile), large blurred gold glows (bg-gold-500/10, blur 120-130px), soft dark card shadows (0 20px 50px -25px rgba(0,0,0,0.65)) and a gold-tinted 'glow' on the hero mockup. Selection color rgba(240,180,41,0.3). Type: Google Font Inter (weights 400-900), font-family Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; tracking-tight on display, tabular figures ('tnum') on numbers. Mood: institutional, trustworthy, high-contrast dark with restrained luxe gold. Keep the accent strictly navy + gold, never introduce teal, purple, or a second hue.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
Sticky top-0 z-50 header on navy-900/80 with backdrop-blur (saturate 140%, blur 14px) and a bottom white/6% border; a 1px gold gradient hairline sits on the very top edge (from-transparent via-gold-500/40 to-transparent). Left: gold gradient logo tile (h-8 w-8 rounded-md) with a small mark + bold 'Lumira' wordmark, then a horizontal nav (Product, Templates with caret chevrons, Customers, Security, Pricing) shown only at lg. Right: a text 'Log in' link (hidden on small) and a solid gold-gradient 'Start designing' pill button with navy text.

### Hero
Two-column hero (lg grid-cols-[1.05fr_1fr]) on navy-900 with grain overlay and two large blurred glows (top-right gold, bottom-left navy). Left: a pill eyebrow badge (gold border + gold/8% fill + tiny gold dot) reading 'SOC 2 Type II · GDPR ready'; a 44->64px extrabold white headline with the phrase 'speed and trust.' in gold clip-text; a slate-300 subparagraph; a button row (solid gold 'Get started free' with arrow icon + outlined glass 'Watch demo' with a gold play icon); and a trust row with two check-shield items in slate-400. Right: a product dashboard mockup in a rounded-2xl navy-850 panel with gold-tinted glow: a mock window header (navy-800, app name + 3 dots, last dot gold) over a navy-900 body containing a 3-up stat-tile row (Conversion 8.4%, Load time 0.4s, Live pages 12 with gold delta text), a 'Signups this quarter' bar chart (8 bars, gold-gradient highlight bars among navy-700 bars, a +38% gold chip), and two list rows (Published in gold, Generating in slate). A floating 'Audit passed / SOC 2 · 0 findings' chip overlaps the bottom-left corner (sm and up).

### Trust logo band
Full-width band on navy-950 with a centered uppercase tracked label 'Trusted by finance & SaaS teams at 30,000+ companies', then a grid of six invented finance-brand logos (icon + bold wordmark, e.g. Vaultline, Northbank, Ledgerly, Quanta, Sterling, Aegis Pay) in muted slate; grid reflows 6 -> 3 (sm) -> 2 (base) columns.

### Feature grid
On navy-900: a left-aligned section header (gold uppercase eyebrow 'The platform', 34->42px extrabold white H2, slate subcopy) then a 3-column (sm:2, base:1) grid of six cards. Each card is rounded-2xl navy-850 with white/7% border and card-shadow, hover border -> gold-500/30; a gold icon tile (h-11 w-11 rounded-xl, gold/12% fill + gold/20% ring), an 18px bold white title, and slate-400 body. Features: Prompt to live site, Infinite canvas, Enterprise components, Sub-second loads, Built-in A/B, Compliance baked in.

### Stats strip
A bordered band (border-y gold-500/15) on navy-950 with grain and a centered top gold gradient hairline; a gold uppercase label then a 4-up (lg) / 2-up (base) row of big stats. Each stat is a 48->60px gold clip-text extrabold number (30k+, 2.3x, 0.4s, 99.99%) with a slate-300 label under it; columns 2-4 carry a left white/8% divider on lg.

### Security / compliance
Two-column split (lg grid-cols-[1fr_1.05fr]) on a navy-950 -> navy-900 gradient with a top white hairline. Left: a gold shield-check pill eyebrow 'Security & compliance', an extrabold H2 'Built to pass the security review.', slate subcopy, and a 3-item check list (Data residency controls; SSO & SCIM; Audit logs & roles) each with a gold rounded check tile and bold white lead-in. Right: a 2x2 grid of compliance badge cards (rounded-2xl navy-850, centered gold icon tile, bold white label, slate caption): SOC 2 Type II, GDPR & CCPA, AES-256, ISO 27001.

### Pricing
On navy-950: centered header (gold 'Pricing' eyebrow, extrabold H2 'Plans that scale with your funnel.', slate subcopy), then a 3-column (lg) / 1-column pricing grid. Starter ($0/mo) and Enterprise (Custom) are navy-900 cards with white/7% border, outlined glass CTA, and a feature list mixing gold check rows and muted slate 'minus' (not-included) rows. The middle Growth ($49/mo) plan is featured: gold-500/40 border, navy-850->navy-900 gradient, a gold shadow, a '-top-3' centered 'Most popular' gold pill, a solid gold 'Start 14-day trial' CTA, and brighter slate-200 features.

### CTA
Centered closing CTA on navy-900 with one large central blurred gold glow: a 36->48px extrabold white headline 'Ship a site your CFO would sign off on.', a slate subparagraph, and a centered button row (solid gold 'Start designing free' with arrow + outlined glass 'Book a demo').

### Footer
Mega-footer on navy-950 with a top white/8% border. A 6-column (lg) grid: a 2-col brand block (gold logo tile + wordmark, slate description, and an 'All systems operational' status pill with a gold dot) plus four link columns (Product, Company, Trust, Resources) with uppercase white headings and slate-400 links that hover gold. A bottom bar (top border) shows the copyright left and three social glyph icons (X, GitHub, LinkedIn) right that hover gold; stacks on mobile.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Sticky blurred nav with a top gold gradient hairline edge and gold-gradient primary pill button (navy label).

### Componente
Product dashboard mockup: rounded panel + mock window chrome (3 dots, last gold), 3 stat tiles, an 8-bar signups chart with gold-gradient highlight bars and a +38% chip, and two status list rows (Published / Generating).

### Componente
Floating 'Audit passed · SOC 2 · 0 findings' shield chip overlapping the hero mockup corner.

### Componente
Pill eyebrow badges: gold border + gold/8% fill + uppercase tracked gold text, sometimes with a gold dot or shield-check icon.

### Componente
Gold clip-text gradient applied to headline phrases and to the four big stat numbers (tabular figures).

### Componente
Feature/badge icon tiles: gold/12% fill squares with a gold/20% ring and a gold line icon.

### Componente
Comparison pricing with a featured center plan: '-top-3' centered 'Most popular' gold pill, gold border, gold shadow, and gold vs muted-slate (minus) feature rows for included vs excluded.

### Componente
Status pill in the footer (gold dot + 'All systems operational') and a social icon row that hovers gold.

## Notas Especiais
Faithful single-page reproduction, no deviation: keep section order (nav, hero, logos, features, stats, security, pricing, CTA, footer), the navy + gold palette, Inter typography, hairline rings over hard borders, and the responsive reflows exactly. Icons are inline SVGs (Lucide/Phosphor-style line icons + a gold lightning-style logo mark); render them crisply at the specified em sizes and keep the last window dot and the logo tile gold. Use the gold accent sparingly for trust, never wash the page in it. No em-dashes anywhere in copy.
